parsed.name: BK 8600系列可编程直流电子负载
parsed.name_en: BK Precision 8600 Series Programmable DC Electronic Load
parsed.description: 这是一款可编程直流电子负载，用于对电源、适配器、电池等直流电源施加受控负载。它支持恒流和恒压工作模式，可测量输入电压与电流，并支持远端采样，适合电源性能评估、放电测试和实验室自动化测试。
parsed.description_en: This is a programmable DC electronic load used to apply a controlled load to DC sources such as power supplies, adapters, and batteries. It supports constant-current and constant-voltage operation, measures input voltage and current, and offers remote sensing, making it suitable for power-source evaluation, discharge testing, and automated laboratory testing.

actions.description: 初始化电子负载，复位为恒流模式并切换到远程控制。
actions.description_en: Initialize the electronic load, reset it to constant-current mode, and switch it to remote control.

actions.description: 设置远端电压采样状态。
设置恒流模式电流设定值。
actions.description_en: Set the current setpoint for constant-current mode.

actions.description: 设置恒压模式电压设定值。
actions.description_en: Set the voltage setpoint for constant-voltage mode.

actions.description: 设置负载输入开关状态。
actions.description_en: Set the load input on/off state.
